name: keel
description: Project-neutral, multi-agent workflow core: a fixed backbone of steps that drives an issue from backlog to done, customised per project via config + add-only Lego extensions.

interface.longDescription: keel drives a GitHub issue end-to-end through a fixed backbone (select, branch, implement, CI, review, test, merge, capture, close) so a coding agent's work reaches a real done, not just a first draft. Project-neutral: every project-specific value is read from .keel/project.yaml via the keel CLI, which must be installed separately (pipx install keel-workflow). The skills drive git and the GitHub CLI in your repository: they create branches and worktrees, push, open, review and merge pull requests, and comment on and label issues.
defaultPrompt: Set up keel in this repository
Ship issue #1 with keel, dry run first
Give me keel's morning briefing for this repository
